findings.title: XSS Vulnerability in Dalgona Challenge XSS25
findings.description: Reflected XSS vulnerability in the solution input field. The application filters 'script', 'onerror', 'onload', and single quotes but allows other event handlers like ontoggle with double quotes.

reproduction.command: POST /xss25 with body solution=<details open ontoggle=alert("XSS")>
